string-array.name: save_water_tips
string-array.item: Know your tank, save your water. Every drop counts.
A tap dripping once a second wastes about 30 litres a day. Fix leaks early.
Turning off the tap while brushing saves around 6 litres a minute.
An overflowing tank wastes water silently. Get an alert before it spills.
A level that drops at night can mean a hidden leak. Your tank is checked every night.
Run the motor only when the tank needs it: see the level before you switch on.
Water saved today is water for tomorrow.

resources.string: For the manufacturer: needs the service login. Only the program is replaced: settings, Wi-Fi, passwords, calibration, history and logs are kept. Keep the phone near the tank and this screen open until the update is confirmed. If the upload is interrupted, the tank keeps running its current firmware.
